history.shared_categories: American (New), Bars, Cajun/Creole, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants

text.text_excerpt: My husband and I had dinner here with friends recently and our experience was definitely worthy of a full 5 stars. We arrived and were greeted by a very friendly hostess who found our reservation and showed us to our table right away. I was struck by how pretty this place is. It is so tastefully decorated - I felt like I was dining in the home of a very stylish good friend. Our waiter arrived, brought menus and took our drink order. He was wonderful! He explained several of his favorite dishes and answered our many questions. He was helpful throughout our meal, kept our table clean, our glasses full, and always seemed to be there when we needed him, but not when we didn't. For appetizers ...

I decided to head over to the brand new Carrollton Market last night for a dinner date. Made a last minute reservation for 7:00. It was not packed, but most of the tables were full. I had dined at One, the previous occupant of this space, and the layout is largely the same. It does have a slighlty more formal feel, but it's not stuffy by any means. They still have the open kitchen, and you could watch Chef Goodenough preparing every dish. Started off with a couple of cocktails, Old Fashioned for me, and a lavender champagne cocktail for the lady. We browsed the menu which has quite a few good looking options. We decided to order 5 appetizers to try as much as possible and passed on entree...

My fiance took me here for my birthday dinner, and it was a perfect date-night-special-occasion place. It was one of the best meals that I have had in a while. The food was delicious and different without trying too hard. We had the Oysters Goodenough as an appetizer, which are completely rich but sooo good. I got the Ricotta Cavatelli and my fiance got the Duck Breast for our entrees. OMG the cavatelli! The pasta is homemade and incorporates ricotta, so its rich and kind of chewy and perfect. They dont skimp on the crabmeat in the dish. I tried my fiance's duck breast, and I really enjoyed the sauce that was on it. They have housemade orangecello and lemoncello, I had a orangecello drink...
